desc: Derive the complement-selection transformation for `K > N-K`.
Implement DFS/backtracking that enumerates all combinations of exactly `R` indices while carrying the current XOR.
Add pruning so recursion only explores indices when enough elements remain to complete the subset.
At each leaf, compute the appropriate candidate XOR and maximize the answer.
Verify edge cases such as `K = N`, `K = 1`, all-zero values, and large values up to `2^60-1`.
